content.text: In `flash_firmware` (`src/agentic_hil/tools.py`, `DebuggerTools.flash_firmware`), when `self.backend.flash_firmware(...)` raises, the `except BaseException` handler sets `self._symbol_elf = None` — discarding the previously remembered symbol-source ELF — before re-raising the exception. This is because `_remember_symbol_elf` (which normally decides whether to keep/replace the symbol source) only runs on a returned result, never on an exception, so a raise means the backend may have partially written the target, making the old ELF no longer provably correct; the code explicitly clears it rather than leaving stale symbol info in place.
